import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int MAXN = 250005;
    static int[][] f = new int[MAXN][18];
    static int[] c = new int[18];
    static int[] ans = new int[18];
    static int[] lg = new int[1];
    static int m, n, k, rhl;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] inv = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] v = new int[MAXN];

    static void arrayAdd(int[] dest, int[] src, int mode) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            dest[i] += mode != 0 ? src[i] : (rhl - src[i]);
            if (dest[i] >= rhl) dest[i] -= rhl;
        }
    }

    static void arrayMultiply(int[] a, int[] b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) c[i] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            if (a[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = 0; i + j < lg[0]; ++j) {
                c[i + j] = (int)((1L * a[i] * b[j] + c[i + j]) % rhl);
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(c, 0, a, 0, lg[0]);
    }

    static void arrayPower(int[] a, int b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) ans[i] = 0;
        ans[0] = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) arrayMultiply(ans, a);
            b >>= 1;
            if (b > 0) arrayMultiply(a, a);
        }
        System.arraycopy(ans, 0, a, 0, lg[0]);
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) res = (int)((1L * res * base) % rhl);
            base = (int)((1L * base * base) % rhl);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        rhl = sc.nextInt();

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(k, n));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = ifac[0] = f[0][0] = 1;
        lg[0] = 0;
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; m <<= 1) {
            lg[0]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            inv[i] = (i == 1) ? 1 : (int)((long)(rhl - rhl / i) * inv[rhl % i] % rhl);
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % rhl);
            ifac[i] = (int)((long)ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % rhl);
            cnt[i] = cnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
            f[i][cnt[i]] = ifac[i];
        }

        v[n] = 1;
        for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) {
            if (v[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = i; j > 0; j &= i) {
                v[j] = 1;
            }
        }

        int m = 1;
        while (m < (1 << lg[0])) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if ((j & m) != 0) {
                    arrayAdd(f[j], f[j ^ m], 1);
                }
            }
            m <<= 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (v[i] != 0) {
                arrayPower(f[i], k);
            }
        }

        m = 1;
        while (m < (1 << lg[0])) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if ((j & m) != 0) {
                    arrayAdd(f[j], f[j ^ m], 0);
                }
            }
            m <<= 1;
        }

        long result = (modPow(k, n) - (long)f[n][cnt[n]] * fac[n] % rhl + rhl) % rhl;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
